en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 8.  It is narrated that Imam Musa Kadhim (a.s.) said, “Just as Allah,  the  Mighty  and  Sublime  showers  mercy  on  His believing  servants  at  the  time  of  Prayers,  He  also  curses some  people.”
He  was  asked,  “Why  are  some  people cursed?”  He  replied,  “Because  they  deny  our  rights  and falsify us.”
